catInfo_mp: MP1000, MP2000, MP3000, MP3500 and MP Corner are multi-stream rotating nozzles with matched precipitation. PRS40 is recommended. Keep MP800 and spray nozzles on separate zones.
catInfo_mp800: MP800 nozzles serve small lawns and planting beds. Their higher precipitation rate requires a separate zone from MP Standard. See the selected model for compatible bodies and operating data.
catInfo_strip: MP-LCS-515, MP-RCS-515 and MP-SS-530 cover narrow rectangular areas along paths and boundaries. Their matched precipitation allows them to share a zone with MP Standard.
catInfo_corner: MP Corner is a rotating nozzle for site corners, with a 45–105° arc and precipitation matched to MP Standard. It is a corner nozzle rather than a strip nozzle.
catInfo_spray: Pro Adjustable 4A and 6A are adjustable-arc spray nozzles. For larger radii, use the corresponding Pro High-Efficiency models. PRS30 is recommended; keep them on separate zones from MP Rotator.
catInfo_prostrip: CS-530, ES-515, LCS-515, RCS-515, SS-530 and SS-918 are rectangular strip spray nozzles. PRS30 is recommended. Their different precipitation rate requires a separate zone from MP Strip.
catInfo_he: Pro High-Efficiency 8A-HE–17A-HE replace the corresponding Pro Adjustable models. PRS30 is recommended. Keep them on separate zones from MP Rotator.
catInfo_fixed: Pro Fixed spray nozzles have fixed arcs and color-coded radii. Check the selected model for available arcs and performance. PRS30 is recommended.
catInfo_short: Short-Radius nozzles serve tight spaces and small planting beds. PRS30 is recommended. Refer to the selected model’s performance table for radius and flow.
catInfo_stream: Hunter Stream Spray Nozzles (S-8A, S-16A). Directed streams for shrubs and beds, not a fan spray. PRS30.
catInfo_rotor: Gear-driven rotors (PGP, PGP Ultra, I-20…). Radius, flow, pressure and nozzle colors depend on the model and selected nozzle. Consult its Hunter performance table. Design separate zones from MP Rotators and sprays.
catInfo_golf: G-70-B, G-75-B, G-80-B and G-85-B golf rotors have flanged bodies. Design separate zones from landscape I-series rotors. Check model-specific documentation for pressure and inlet specifications.
catInfo_st: Hunter ST System for stadiums and synthetic turf: ST-90, STG-900 and ST-1600. Each model has its own pressure, radius and flow range; see the selected nozzle performance table. Use separate zones from landscape rotors.
catInfo_bubbler: MSBN, MSBN-V, PCN, PCB, PCB-R, AFB and 5-CST-B bubblers irrigate trees and shrubs. Mounting and flow depend on the model. Keep them on separate zones from spray nozzles and MP Rotator.

recMoistSun: Keep soil moist and well drained, especially in full sun.
recMoistEstablished: Maintain evenly moist soil. Established plants tolerate some drought.
recMoistLoam: Prefers moist, well-drained loam; tolerates drought once established.
recDryDrainage: Prefers well-drained soil on the dry side. Excess moisture encourages root rot.

descDaylily: Rhizomatous perennial with orange flowers, quickly forming dense, spreading clumps.

hunterDescription.mpStandard: A nozzle with several slowly rotating streams that apply water evenly at a low rate.
hunterDescription.mp800: A rotating multi-stream nozzle for smaller spaces. It applies water faster than standard MP Rotator nozzles and belongs to a different precipitation group.
hunterDescription.mpStrip: A rotating multi-stream nozzle that waters a rectangular strip, useful beside paths and in narrow planting areas.
hunterDescription.adjustableSpray: A fan-spray nozzle with an adjustable arc, allowing the spray edges to follow irregular landscape boundaries.
hunterDescription.highEfficiencySpray: An adjustable spray nozzle designed for uniform coverage and clearly defined edges. Its easy-grip top can also close the flow completely.
hunterDescription.fixedSpray: A spray nozzle with a predefined watering pattern. Choose the pattern to suit the shape of the lawn or planting bed.
hunterDescription.shortSpray: A short-radius micro-spray nozzle for small beds and compact planting areas.
hunterDescription.streamSpray: An archived nozzle that distributes separate streams across an adjustable arc, retained for identifying existing equipment.
hunterDescription.rotorResidential: A rotor that sweeps a stream across the lawn. Interchangeable nozzles tailor its throw and flow to the site.
hunterDescription.rotorLarge: A rotor for large lawns, parks and sports fields. Its rotating nozzle assembly distributes water over a broad area.
hunterDescription.rotorOpposed: A full-circle rotor with nozzles on opposite sides of the turret, improving close-in and mid-range water distribution.
hunterDescription.rotorGolf: A golf and large-turf rotor with primary and secondary nozzles. Top-access servicing simplifies maintenance.
hunterDescription.rotorSport: A specialist rotor for wetting synthetic sports turf, used in field-conditioning systems.
hunterDescription.bubblerStreams: A bubbler nozzle that directs separate streams toward planting root zones, useful for trees and larger shrubs.
hunterDescription.bubblerCompensated: A pressure-compensating bubbler for localized root-zone watering. It maintains a steady output within its operating pressure range.
hunterDescription.bubblerAdjustable: A flood bubbler with manually adjustable output, from a gentle trickle to an umbrella pattern, for localized planting irrigation.
rainBirdDescription.heVan: Adjustable-arc spray nozzle with large droplets and close-in watering for even lawn coverage.
rainBirdDescription.van: Spray nozzle for small lawns and irregular planting areas, with an arc set by turning the collar.
rainBirdDescription.uSeries: Fixed-arc spray nozzle with a second outlet that waters close to the sprinkler.
rainBirdDescription.mpr: Fixed-pattern spray nozzle from the MPR family, with matched precipitation across its patterns.
rainBirdDescription.flat: Fixed-arc spray nozzle with a low trajectory for exposed or windy areas.
rainBirdDescription.strip: Strip spray nozzle for narrow rectangular lawns and planting areas.
rainBirdDescription.rvan: Rotary nozzle that waters with multiple rotating streams; throw adjusts by hand without tools.
rainBirdDescription.rvanStrip: Rotary strip nozzle with rotating streams for narrow rectangular areas.
rainBirdDescription.sq: Low-volume nozzle with preset square or partial-square patterns for small beds and planting areas.
rainBirdDescription.bubblerAdjustable: Flood bubbler for trees, shrubs and flowers; a screw adjusts or shuts off the flow.
rainBirdDescription.bubblerCompensated: Bubbler for trees and planting beds that maintains constant flow within its specified pressure range.
rainBirdDescription.streamBubbler: Stream bubbler that delivers water through separate low streams.
rainBirdDescription.rotor3500: Compact gear-driven rotor for small lawns, with top arc adjustment and interchangeable nozzles.
rainBirdDescription.rotor5000: Rotor for residential and commercial turf; Rain Curtain nozzles distribute water across the full throw.
rainBirdDescription.rotorFalcon: Rotor for large lawns, parks and sports fields, with Rain Curtain nozzles that water the near, middle and far zones.
rainBirdDescription.rotor8005: Rotor for sports fields and large lawns; Memory Arc restores the set arc after the turret is forcibly turned.
equipment.use.rotaryMulti: Rotating nozzle that waters lawns with several moving streams.
equipment.use.adjustableSpray: Spray nozzle with an adjustable watering sector, shaped to suit lawn edges and corners.
equipment.use.fixedSpray: Spray nozzle with a preset watering pattern. Choose the pattern to suit the area being watered.
equipment.use.stripSpray: Spray nozzle for strips of lawn, with a pattern designed for placement at the edge or within the strip.
equipment.use.gearRotor: Gear-driven sprinkler that sweeps a water jet across the lawn.
precipStripOverlap: Straight-line spacing with 50% overlap, as specified in the Rain Bird chart.
precipCalculated: Calculated from flow and radius with sprinkler spacing equal to the throw radius; this is a calculated value, not a published table value.
precipLayoutRequired: Precipitation and run time require a sprinkler spacing layout.
precipFlowOnly: Use flow rate for this local watering pattern; area precipitation and run time for a target depth do not apply.
precipStripPublished: Published Toro strip-layout rates. Actual application depends on sprinkler spacing; these are not single-nozzle rates without overlap. Run time is a reference calculation for the table’s square strip layout.
equipment.rowReviewHint: Some published rows conflict. Verified operating points remain available; rows marked ⚠ and interpolation across them are excluded from calculations.
equipment.rotationUnverified: The manufacturer does not clearly confirm the full-circle rotation mechanism. The coverage is shown, but the 360° animation is unavailable.
equipment.description.kRain.bubblerCompe: Pressure-compensating bubbler for watering trees and large shrubs at the root zone. Its umbrella pattern delivers a fixed flow throughout the specified pressure range.
equipment.description.kRain.bubblerAdjus: Adjustable bubbler that applies water around trees and shrubs with an umbrella pattern. The flow is set on the head.
equipment.description.kRain.highLow: Fixed-pattern nozzle with a long-throw portion on one side and a short-throw portion on the other. Available with male or female threads.
equipment.description.kRain.rpsSelect: Gear-driven rotor with four built-in nozzles. A selector on top changes the active nozzle without removing and replacing it.

equipment.groupConfigured: Zone compatibility depends on nozzle, arc, pressure and spacing. Automatic selection checks the sprinklers already in the current zone.
equipment.groupLayout: Strip precipitation depends on spacing and overlap; check the layout before combining zones.
equipment.groupLocalized: Local watering is selected by plant demand, not by a common sector precipitation rate.
flowSectorEstimate: Estimated flow for this adjustable sector, based on the manufacturer’s matched-precipitation specification; not a separately published table value.
sqSizeHint: Throw and pressure are set separately. Different settings may have the same flow rate, as shown in the manufacturer’s table.
